# Round Colour Designs

> Round Colour Designs is a founder-led interior design studio based in Mulund West, Mumbai, serving MMR and selected projects across Maharashtra.

## Primary information
- Website: https://www.roundcolourdesigns.com/
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98339 92725
- Address: 31, Saidham Shopping Plaza, Mulund West, Mumbai, Maharashtra
- Founders: Akshay Vanare and Pratibha Vanare
- Established: 2022
- Tagline: Shaping Dreams

## Services
- Residential interior design
- Commercial and office interiors
- Restaurant and hospitality interiors
- Bungalow, villa and farmhouse interiors
- Space planning, 2D drawings and 3D visualisation
- Modular kitchens, wardrobes and storage solutions
- Custom furniture and lighting design
- Renovation, site supervision and turnkey execution
